beforePause.dialog:
OPERATOR HANDBOOK
×
MOVE WITH PURPOSE.
MOVE gently for small steps. Swipe RIGHT to turn right, LEFT to turn left. Long scene swipes turn faster; FIRE-drag and AIM stay precise.
MAP pauses to plan. Walking shows the next clear ground step. Approach each floor ring; HOLD TO RECOVER lights up when ready. Stay still and hold it.
After three memories, destroy the numbered copper coils. Amber means cover; cyan means an exposed firing window. Move to a clear face.
When the jammer falls, return to the marked uplink deck and survive the upload. DASH helps reposition; JUMP becomes VAULT near low cover.
FULL TACTICAL HANDBOOK
UNDERSTOOD
